Title: SMC MGPM25TF-100AZ CMP GDE+AIR CUSH Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: MGPM25TF-100AZ
DESCRIPTION: MGP-AZ, Compact Guide Cylinder, Air Cushion
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 25 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 100 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 25 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 10 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 25 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 300 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we are always innovating and our latest guided cylinder the MGPW is no exception. This new wide guided cylinder has been designed to handle large work pieces and has enhanced plate rotation torque that is three times larger than the standard MGP Series and has improved non-rotating accuracy of the plate. Although similar in weight to the MGP, the MGPW has 170% more volume by using anodised aluminium and optimising the dimensions of various components. Easy to set-up and mount, therefore reducing labour costs, the MGPW can be used with two colour D-M9*W indication solid state auto switches or alternative round auto switches which can be fitted directly onto the cylinder. Ideal for the transfer of large work pieces and those with eccentric loads, the MGPW has three types of bearing and mounting options as standard and can manage several applications, such as lifting and pushing.
BULLET POINTS: A wide guided cylinder specialised in the stability and moment of large work pieces. Plate allowable rotation torque tripled (in comparison with the basic type) by doubling the guide pitch. Non-rotating accuracy of the plate is improved (with respect to the basic type) due to the increase in the guide pitch. Equivalent weight to the basic type, even though the volume is 170% more than the basic MGP.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

DESCRIPTION: MGP-AZ, Compact Guide Cylinder, Air Cushion
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 32 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 250 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.

Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: MGP-AZ, Compact Guide Cylinder, Air Cushion
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 32 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 50 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Title: SMC MGPM32TF-75Z Guided Cylinder Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: MGPM32TF-75Z
DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 32 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 75 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. Title: SMC MGPM40TF-100AZ 01112314 Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: MGP-AZ, Compact Guide Cylinder, Air Cushion
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 40 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 100 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 40 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 125 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Title: SMC MGPM40TF-50AZ CMP GDE+AIR CUSH Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: MGP-AZ, Compact Guide Cylinder, Air Cushion
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 40 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 50 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 50 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 100 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Title: SMC MGPM50TF-150Z COMPACT CYLINDER Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: MGPM50TF-150Z
DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 50 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 150 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 50 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 300 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: MGP-AZ, Compact Guide Cylinder, Air Cushion
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 50 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Stroke: 50 mm Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire or Prewired Connector: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number: 2 pcs. [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Made to Order: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: With Air Cushion. 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 80 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 100 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 80 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 125 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

Title: SMC MGPM80TF-25Z Compact Cylinder Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: MGPM80TF-25Z
DESCRIPTION: MGP-Z, Compact Guide Cylinder
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 80 mm Port Thread Type: TF [G] Lube-retainer: Without Stable Lubrication Function Stroke: 25 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m [Or None in the Case of No Switch] Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. [Or None in Case of No Switch] Change of Guide Rod End Shape: None Temperature Resistance: None Low Speed: None Fluororubber Seal: None Grease for Food Processing Equipment: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Compactness & Lightness Bore size: 12, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 (mm) Strokes from 10 to 400mm (depending upon bore size) 4 types of mounting are possible: top mounting, side mounting, bottom mounting and T-slot side mounting. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we have 'rolled' out an upgrade of our MGP Series guide cylinder, which is now smaller and boasts new features. The new MGP-Z is testament to our commitment to invest in ongoing research and development to refine and improve the performance and functionality of SMC products. The MGP-Z is up to 17% lighter and offers space savings thanks to shorter guide rods, without impacting on the variety of functions, robustness and quality performance of the original series. Another recent key development feature is that round auto switches can now be fitted directly onto the MGP-Z cylinder, removing the need for mounting brackets and reducing labour costs. The common issue of incorrectly positioned auto switches is also mitigated when using SMC's two colour indication solid state auto switch, D-M9*W. The MGP-Z has many standard feature options including three types of bearings, four mount designs, piping from two directions and offers cooper and fluorine free versions. Suitable for many industries including General Automation and Car, it has several applications including smooth pusher and lifter, lateral load by acting as a stopper where shock is applied, or minimising plate displacement.
BULLET POINTS: 3 types of bearing can be selected: slide bearing, ball bushing and high precision ball bushing. Auto switches can be mounted on 2 surfaces.

DESCRIPTION: MGPW, Compact Guide Cylinder/Wide type
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Bearing Type: M (Slide Bearing) Bore Size: diameter 25 Port Thread Type: TF (G) Stroke: 100 Auto Switch: No Switch Lead Wire Length: 0.5m (Or None in the Case of No Switch) Number of Auto Switches: 2 pcs. (Or None in the Case of No Switch)
LONG DESCRIPTION: At SMC we are always innovating and our latest guided cylinder the MGPW is no exception. This new wide guided cylinder has been designed to handle large work pieces and has enhanced plate rotation torque that is three times larger than the standard MGP Series and has improved non-rotating accuracy of the plate. Although similar in weight to the MGP, the MGPW has 170% more volume by using anodised aluminium and optimising the dimensions of various components. Easy to set-up and mount, therefore reducing labour costs, the MGPW can be used with two colour D-M9*W indication solid state auto switches or alternative round auto switches which can be fitted directly onto the cylinder. Ideal for the transfer of large work pieces and those with eccentric loads, the MGPW has three types of bearing and mounting options as standard and can manage several applications, such as lifting and pushing.
BULLET POINTS: A wide guided cylinder specialised in the stability and moment of large work pieces. Plate allowable rotation torque tripled (in comparison with the basic type) by doubling the guide pitch. Non-rotating accuracy of the plate is improved (with respect to the basic type) due to the increase in the guide pitch. Equivalent weight to the basic type, even though the volume is 170% more than the basic MGP.
